description: This source file contains utility functions for handling cryptographic large integers and primes using SSLeay/OpenSSL libraries. It includes functions for converting custom large number structures to OpenSSL's BIGNUM format, managing endianness conversions, and setting data for cryptographic primitives.

methods.name: BIGNUM * AnscCryptoPubPrime2BigNum(PANSC_CRYPTO_PRIME pLargePrime)
methods.description: Converts a custom prime structure to an OpenSSL BIGNUM, handling endianness conversion if needed.

methods.name: BIGNUM * AnscCryptoPubInteger2BigNum(PANSC_CRYPTO_INTEGER pLargeInteger)
methods.description: Converts a custom integer structure to an OpenSSL BIGNUM, handling endianness conversion if needed.

methods.name: void AnscCryptoPubBigEndianInteger2Integer(PANSC_CRYPTO_INTEGER pInteger,PANSC_CRYPTO_INTEGER pBigEndianInteger)
methods.description: Converts a big endian integer structure to a native format, respecting endianness.

methods.name: void AnscCryptoPubBigEndianPrime2Prime(PANSC_CRYPTO_PRIME pPrime,PANSC_CRYPTO_PRIME pBigEndianPrime)
methods.description: Converts a big endian prime structure to a native format, preserving data and size.

methods.name: void AnscCryptoPubSetInteger(PANSC_CRYPTO_INTEGER pInteger,PUCHAR pData,ULONG ulData)
methods.description: Sets the value of a custom integer structure from raw data.

methods.name: void AnscCryptoPubSetPrime(PANSC_CRYPTO_PRIME pPrime,PUCHAR pData,ULONG ulData)
methods.description: Sets the value of a custom prime structure from raw data.
